definitions.explanation: Highly polite way of asking who someone is. Used in formal service contexts such as hotels, receptions, and business settings. More deferential than どなた alone.

examples.japanese: どなた{様|さま}で⟦いらっしゃいます→いらっしゃる：01295_irassharu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦インターホン→インターホン：04885_intaahon⟧{越|ご}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「どなた{様|さま}です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I confirmed through the intercom, "Who is it?"

examples.japanese: ⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{担当者|たんとうしゃ}→担当者：09676_tantousha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「どなた{様|さま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧でしょう⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: The receptionist asked, "Whose reservation is it?"

notes:
The most polite form of "who." Composed of ⟦どなた→どなた：02923_donata⟧ (polite form of だれ) + 様 (honorific suffix).

POLITENESS SCALE:
- だれ: who (plain)
- ⟦どなた→どなた：02923_donata⟧: who (polite/respectful)
- どなた{様|さま}: who (very polite; formal service language)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- どなた{様|さま}です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: who are you? (formal)
- どなた{様|さま}で⟦いらっしゃいます→いらっしゃる：01295_irassharu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: who might you be? (very formal)
- どなた{様|さま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いらっしゃいます→いらっしゃる：01295_irassharu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: who is there? (formal)

Typically used by service staff (hotels, restaurants, receptions) and in formal business contexts.
